kept.spine: The town lives on a short list of trades, and no one of them would keep it alone.

kept.poolKey: TRADE PROFILE: exports and imports both present
kept.spine: Goods made here and goods brought in stand on the same stalls, and nothing about them tells a stranger which is which.
Something always goes out of this town, and when one trade is quiet another is not.
Spitzplatz is fed and has nothing to spare.
The Caravaneer's post stands open and in good repair. What it handles comes from further off, and that supply has failed.

The unlicensed trade here is small, and something is behind it all the same: shops trading on goods nobody saw come in, and a gang on the streets nobody has named. Who they answer to is in no account at all, and it would be worth knowing.
